title: Clock parts: self-driven evolution, ticking, ring clock, reading and resolution

key_results.statement: Sufficient condition for a self-driven part: $C_\partial=\mathbb 1_K\otimes B$ with $B=B^\dagger$ on $\mathcal H_R$ (cross terms act trivially on $K$).
$K$ is self-driven iff $\operatorname{Tr}_R[C_\partial,X]=0$ for every operator $X$ on $\mathcal H_{\rm adm}$; for $\mathcal H_{\rm adm}=\mathcal H$ this is equivalent to (2.1).
Counterexample to the necessity of (2.1): $C=D\otimes\mathbb 1+\mathbb 1\otimes D+gP_{12}$ for two identical-type objects makes $K=\{1\}$ self-driven although $gP_{12}\neq\mathbb 1\otimes B$.
For a self-driven $K$, $p(r;\lambda)=\operatorname{Tr}(\Pi_r e^{-iC_K\lambda}V_K(0)e^{iC_K\lambda})$: the statistics depend on $R$ only through $V_K(0)$.
$V_K(\lambda)=\sum_{j,l}e^{-i(E_j-E_l)\lambda}P_jV_0P_l$ and $p(r;\lambda)=\sum_{j,l}e^{-i(E_j-E_l)\lambda}\operatorname{Tr}(\Pi_rP_jV_0P_l)$.
Some reading on $K$ ticks iff there are a place $m$ and a gap $\omega\neq0$ with $\sum_{E_j-E_l=\omega}\langle m|P_jV_0P_l|m\rangle\neq0$; then the place reading ticks.
$\{\lambda':V_K(\lambda')=V_K(\lambda)\}=\lambda+\mathcal T$ with $\mathcal T=\{s:\omega s\in2\pi\mathbb Z\ \forall\omega\in\Omega\}$, $\Omega=\{E_j-E_l:P_jV_0P_l\neq0\}$.

The view indexes $\lambda$ on all of $\mathbb R$ iff $\Omega$ has two nonzero gaps with irrational ratio; otherwise, for $\mathcal T=\tau\mathbb Z$, the maximal intervals are half-open of length $\tau=2\pi/\omega_*$, and none for $\mathcal T=\mathbb R$.

$K$ is a uniform ring clock with tick $\lambda_0$ iff $C_K=\sum_kE_k|v_k\rangle\langle v_k|$, $|v_k\rangle=N^{-1/2}\sum_m e^{2\pi ikm/N}e^{i\alpha_m}|m\rangle$, $E_k=\varepsilon+2\pi\ell_k/(N\lambda_0)$, $\ell_k\equiv k$ mod $N$.
Ring clock from $|0\rangle$: $p(m;\lambda)=|G(m;\lambda)|^2$, $G(m;\lambda)=N^{-1}\sum_k e^{2\pi i\ell_k(m-\lambda/\lambda_0)/N}$, independent of the $\theta_m$.
$\Delta C_K=\frac{2\pi}{N\lambda_0}[N^{-1}\sum_k\ell_k^2-(N^{-1}\sum_k\ell_k)^2]^{1/2}$ for the start $|0\rangle$.
$\min\Delta C_K=\frac{2\pi}{\lambda_0}\sqrt{(N^2-1)/(12N^2)}$, attained iff the $\ell_k$ are $N$ consecutive integers (equally spaced levels, spacing $2\pi/(N\lambda_0)$).
Minimal member: $p(m;\lambda)=\sin^2(\pi\lambda/\lambda_0)/[N^2\sin^2(\pi(\lambda/\lambda_0-m)/N)]$.
A place reading with outcome $m$ maps the view of $K$ to $\Pi_mV_K\Pi_m/\operatorname{Tr}(\Pi_mV_K)=|m\rangle\langle m|$.
Readings at $\lambda_1<\lambda_2$ ($\theta_m=0$): $P(m_1,m_2)=p(m_1;\lambda_1)\,p(m_2-m_1;\lambda_2-\lambda_1)$.
Unrecorded first reading: $P_2(m_2)=\sum_{m_1}p(m_1;\lambda_1)p(m_2-m_1;\Delta)$; it differs from $p(m_2;\lambda_2)$ by the interference terms with $m_1\neq m_1'$.

No change if $\lambda_1$ or $\lambda_2-\lambda_1$ lies in $\lambda_0\mathbb Z$; for the minimal member the first reading changes the second distribution iff $\lambda_1,\lambda_2-\lambda_1\notin\lambda_0\mathbb Z$, with $|\hat D|=4(N-1)N^{-2}|\sin\pi x_1\sin\pi x_\Delta|$.
$n$ readings at $j\lambda/n$: $P_n=|N^{-1}\sum_k e^{-2\pi i\ell_k\lambda/(nN\lambda_0)}|^{2n}=e^{-\lambda^2\Delta C_K^2/n+O(n^{-3})}\to1$ as $n\to\infty$.
$\lim_{\lambda'\to\lambda}\theta(\lambda,\lambda')/|\lambda'-\lambda|=\Delta C_K$, independent of $\lambda$.
$\theta(\lambda,\lambda')\le\Delta C_K|\lambda'-\lambda|$; orthogonality of $\psi(\lambda')$ and $\psi(\lambda)$ requires $|\lambda'-\lambda|\ge\pi/(2\Delta C_K)$.
Minimal ring clock: $\lambda_\perp=\lambda_0$, ratio $r_N=\frac{2}{\sqrt3}\sqrt{1-N^{-2}}\to2/\sqrt3$, bound attained only for $N=2$.

open_issues: Necessity of (2.1) is shown only for H_adm = H; with identical-type objects across the cut only (2.2) and the counterexample (2.3) are given, and the label-free specification of such parts (A7, M6) is not treated.
The 'only if' part of (2.17) is proven only for the minimal member; other members have further no-change values of Δ (e.g. N = 2, ℓ = (0,3)).
Item 4 assumes that post-reading states are admissible (no object of R has the type of k).
Indexing on all of ℝ in (2.8) is exact injectivity only; quasi-periodic near-recurrences limiting finite-resolution readings are not quantified.
Out of scope: time relative to other parts, clock comparison, recording contracts, clocks that are not self-driven.

consistency_checks.check: Units (ΔC_K ∝ 1/λ0, bound ∝ λ0, r_N dimensionless) and normalization of (2.10), (2.15), (2.16)
N = 2: direct computation of p(0;λ), ΔC_K, D(0) and λ⊥ agrees with (2.13), (2.12), (2.17), (2.21)
Start commuting with C_K: no ticking, T = ℝ, no indexing interval, no orthogonality, consistent with (2.5)–(2.8), (2.20)
